source_context.units_evidence: Associated acquisition code divides acceleration by 16384 LSB/g and gyro by 131 LSB/(degree/s). Exact capture firmware revision is not recorded in the CSV.
source_context.sampling_evidence: Associated acquisition code specifies 50 Hz and 50 samples; corroborated by all within-recording CSV intervals.
source_context.axis_evidence: Associated code preserves sensor register axes; mounting relative to dataset-v1's gesture frame is undocumented.
source_context.idle_evidence: Associated README describes idle as resting hand positions; supports only the broad idle/non-motion label correspondence.
provenance_limitations: Kaggle describes ESP32 while the current linked implementation describes ESP8266; exact capture revision is unknown.
The CSV has 300 distinct sample_id values reused across labels, not 300 independently identifiable participant sessions.
Participant identities, session boundaries, sensor mounting and calibration are absent.
Kaggle page exposes both CC BY 4.0 and CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 text; resolve applicable dataset version terms before redistribution or future reuse.
